title: Project-R game-specific emulator fork registry
description: emu_forks_registry.json as loaded by pr-builder (src/pr_builder/registry.py, v0.1.0): emulator -> game id -> fork. pr-builder treats EVERY top-level key as an emulator, so no other top-level keys (not even `$schema`) are allowed. Fields pr-builder reads are title, fork_repo, fork_reason and stability; source, title_id_source and notes are registry-only provenance.

shadps4.description: ShadPS4 forks keyed by PS4 title id (pr-builder reads it from PARAM.SFO as a CUSAxxxxx token).

kytyps5.description: KytyPS5 forks keyed by PS5 title id (PPSAxxxxx).

fork_repo.description: HTTPS git clone URL of the fork (default branch is the one meant to be built).

fork_reason.description: What the fork changes for this game, in the fork author's terms.

stability.description: `stable` forks are used automatically by pr-builder; `experimental` ones only on user choice.

source.description: Permalink showing the fork targets this title id (fork README or source code).

title_id_source.description: Independent confirmation that the title id belongs to this game (e.g. the shadPS4 game-compatibility tracker).
